Sir,
Please refer to this office letters cited above.

2. As achieving ISO 9001:2008 certification is a mandatory success indicator of the RFD 2012-13 &
2013-14 & 2014-15, it is therefore once again requested to take necessary steps to review the areas
required to be improved for getting the said certificate at the earliest to ensure that EPF offices under your
jurisdiction are able to obtain ISO certification.

3, As per Headquarters record, only two offices namely SRO, Jabalpur and SRO, Barrackpore have
obtained the ISO:9001 certification.

3. You may also indicate the tentative dates (in respect of each of the offices under your jurisdiction)

by which the office shall be ready to apply for getting ISO certification.
Yours faithfully,

x. wogatay”)
